subject: af-comp
title: A.F.COMP.------POL.SIGN.
description: Chart on book p. 49 (BK(NM)-25). AF-COMP (affinity compression) (the title writes A.F.COMP.) is the subject; POL-SIGN (political significance) is the partner. From the subject: POL-P (political policies), TRS (transition) and SOC-RT-DT (social reality dictates). From POL-P: IST-F-ACT. From IST-F-ACT: SOC-RT-P (social reality particulars). From TRS: CN-INFO (controlled information). From CN-INFO: RE-DOC (redocumentation). From RE-DOC: JR-DYM (journalism dynamics). From SOC-RT-DT: INFO-DY. From INFO-DY: INFO-F-DT. From INFO-F-DT: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". The page text below the chart begins "The social-reality dictates of creative black music".
